title: CROWS
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Harumichi Bouya transfers into Suzuran All-Boys High, a school of delinquents the locals call the Crows, and his brawls grow into wars between factions and gangs. Rivals become friends through fights as he moves from transfer to graduation; it is the prequel to Worst (Kodama blurb via AniList and MangaUpdates; MyAnimeList reviews).
life_message: Respect, friendship and pride are earned by fighting fair, never preying on the weak.

content.note: Constant street fights and gang wars, sometimes with bats or pipes, but no gore (MAL reviews); MU Street Fighting, Gang Wars; AniList Gangs, Martial Arts.
Reviewers say it is not dark (MAL).
Reviewers note almost no women in the story (MAL).
MU Rude Character/s; delinquent talk likely (to verify).
Fighting shown as fun and a path to respect; reviewers fault the 'lack of consequences' (MAL); AniList Delinquents (98).

dominant: Strength as respect; loyalty among delinquents; code of fair fighting

frames.aligns: Loyalty, friendship and defending the weak.
frames.concerns: Brawling as recreation and the way to respect; violence without consequence.
Fighting glorified; smoking and rough talk.

frames.aligns: Talk-starter on friendship and real strength.
frames.concerns: Violence as the path to respect; no adults or faith.

frames.aligns: Common grace in loyalty and fairness.
frames.concerns: Fifth and sixth commandments flouted for fun.

frames.aligns: Fair play as a moral code.

frames.concerns: Violence shown as heroic is the whole story.

Delinquency and disrespect for school authority.

frames.aligns: Warrior honor and keeping one's word.

frames.concerns: Violence and coarse speech; wasted time.

Dignity vs honor.evidence: Pride drives the story and respect is learned through fighting (MAL reviews).

Order vs freedom.evidence: No teachers or normal students to speak of; delinquents run the school (MAL review).

Civic vs kin.evidence: Faction and gang loyalty first (MU Gang/s; Kodama blurb).

Equality vs hierarchy.evidence: Factions with leaders, but Bouya respects rivals as equals (MAL).

Tradition vs secular-rational.evidence: Neither faith nor reason; a street code.

Survival vs self-expression.evidence: Style, bikes and pompadours as self-display (MAL), alongside status struggles.

folkways.japan: Draws on the Japanese yankii delinquent subculture of the 1990s, with its pompadours, bikes and codes of seniority among students.

delivery.evidence: MAL reviewers see values like not preying on the weak in the fights themselves; none mention lecturing.
delivery.note: Its fighting code is shown by who wins and who is shamed rather than stated, and non-violent viewpoints hardly appear.

winners_losers: Fighters who fight fair earn friends and respect; those who ambush or target the helpless lose face. The delinquent code gets the story's sympathy.
